hints.title: Bitwise Independence
hints.text: Each bit position b from 0 to 30 can be evaluated completely independently.

hints.title: Bit Frequency Count
hints.text: For each bit position b, count how many elements in nums have the b-th bit set.

hints.title: Bit Activation
hints.text: If the count is at least k, add 2^b to the result.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining bit frequencies takes constant passes over array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bit masks (1 << b) to count active bits across the numbers.
